tooltips.prompt: Text prompt for the video. Optional when there is an image parameter.
tooltips.negativePrompt: A text string explaining what the model should avoid generating.
tooltips.image: An image to use as the first frame of the video. When there is an image, the prompt parameter is optional.
tooltips.personGeneration: Controls whether the model can generate videos with people. 'dont_allow' prevents people/faces, 'allow_adult' allows only adults.
tooltips.videoLength: Output video length in seconds (5-8 seconds).
tooltips.aspectRatio: Change the aspect ratio of the generated video. Supported values are '16:9' and '9:16'. Default is '16:9'.
tooltips.promptRunway: Text prompt for the video (maximum 1000 characters). Should describe what you want to appear in the output.
tooltips.imageRunway: An image to use as the first frame of the video.
tooltips.seed: Optional seed value (0 to 4294967295). Using the same seed with the same parameters results in similar outputs.
tooltips.videoLengthRunway: Output video length in seconds (5 or 10 seconds).
tooltips.aspectRatioRunway: Resolution of the output video. Available options in gen4_turbo: 1280:720, 720:1280, 1104:832, 832:1104, 960:960, 1584:672
